ops.text: Nov 1 11:40 PM: the skills marketplace clone under ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/skills was left half-replaced (no .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, no .git, a stale skills..clone from 11:37 PM beside it). claude plugin update warned 'marketplace not refreshed' and desk-runner.py handoff crashed with FileNotFoundError on marketplace.json; another session sat in an until-loop waiting on it. Re-running claude plugin marketplace update skills restored it. Something swapped the clone outside the .update.lock lockf wrapper or died mid-swap.
